name: g_umaCupFlagTable
comment: Lookup table mapping each of the 5 horse race (uma) cup tiers (0..4: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Black Cup) to its global progress/unlock flag offset in game work (+0x27508). Each 4-byte entry packs a {u16 cupIndex, u16 flagOffset} pair (flag offsets 0x017B..0x017F). Read by Flag_GetGlobalIndexed (0x001A5AE4) to test if a cup's flag is set in the save work flag block, by Ui_UmaWindow_InitEntryFlags (0x004CC9EC) to initialize cup entry flags via the party manager, by maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_InitFromFlags (0x005A6A20) to populate cup unlock states, and by Ui_RecipeInfo_IsUnlocked (0x004503F4) for cup recipe rewards.
evidence: Located in .rodata at 0x0072B20C immediately preceding the 6-byte Uma page selection table at 0x0072B220 and the Ui_UmaWindow function pointer table at 0x0072B228. Referenced exclusively by literals 0x001A5B24 in Flag_GetGlobalIndexed and 0x004CCB2C in Ui_UmaWindow_InitEntryFlags. Both functions index with stride 4 (cupIndex * 4) and fetch the u16 flag offset at offset +2, referencing flag indices 0x017B..0x017F in the work flag array at +0x27508. maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_InitFromFlags queries all 5 indices (0..4) and Ui_RecipeInfo_IsUnlocked checks index < 5.
